english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an adult male or men collectively, including a male member of a group when the role is clear from context.
Use this for the male-person meaning, rather than for a companion or a generic individual.
Use this as the all-purpose word when “gentleman” simply means a man.
Choose this over 男仔 when the male person is an adult man.

examples.english: That man is the new colleague.
examples.traditional: 嗰個男人係新嚟嘅同事。
